Reviewed claim rows PFP002-07, PFP002-08, and PFP002-10.

claims.statement: For the introductory 3-state matrix, candidates 000 and 001 fail off-diagonal nonpositivity; an initial search with node budget 2 returns status UNKNOWN on frontier interval [2, 8), and resumption with node budget 1 from that frontier verifies gauge 010 at candidate index 2.
dependencies: Finite 3-state real matrix RUNNING in declared basis with lexicographic gauge order.
Resumable frontier candidate evaluation and contiguous receipt chaining protocol in frontier_search.py.
claims.limits: Applies to the fixed 3-state introductory matrix and lexicographic candidate enumeration; does not establish polynomial-time search on general graphs or eliminate sign problems for arbitrary quantum Hamiltonians.

claims.statement: Exact pairwise cancellation of a signed multiset into equal-weight zero-sum pairs requires a fixed-point-free involution pairing opposite signs with equal magnitudes; a nonnegative total sum alone does not suffice, as demonstrated by the counterexample multiset {+2, -1, -1}.
dependencies: Finite signed multiset with positive magnitudes and signs in {-1, +1}.
Pairwise cancellation defined as partition into disjoint zero-sum pairs.
claims.limits: Applies to equal-weight pairwise (2-term) involutive cancellation certificates; does not exclude multi-term regroupings or higher-order cluster cancellations.

claims.statement: The matrix checker and presentation digest generator consume the same immutable in-memory snapshot of a one-shot matrix input, ensuring that single-pass streams and iterators cannot produce divergent digests or empty-matrix evaluations.
dependencies: Eager tuple-of-tuples snapshotting in exact_matrix_digest and search_exact_matrix after 2026-09-24 repair.
Single traversal consumption of one-shot iterators.
claims.limits: Ensures consistency under the declared Python memory model for matrices fitting in memory; does not address out-of-core streaming or external memory corruption.
